statements.impact_statement: image-size resolves only as a transitive dependency of @docusaurus/mdx-loader 3.10.2, which measures documentation images while the site is built. The images it reads are the repository-controlled files committed under docs/, so a crafted buffer of the kind this advisory requires cannot be supplied. The published site is static output and performs no image parsing at request time. No patched release exists for any published version, so the finding is accepted rather than upgraded away.
statements.status_notes: Dependency path: docs/docusaurus/package-lock.json pins image-size 2.0.2, required as image-size ^2.0.2 by @docusaurus/mdx-loader 3.10.2. The same acceptance is recorded as an allowlist entry in audit-ci.json and as an allowed-advisory entry in .github/workflows/dependency-review.yml. Revisit when upstream publishes a patched image-size release or Docusaurus relaxes the ^2.0.2 constraint.

statements.impact_statement: The committed moderation environment resolves Transformers 5.16.1, later than the 5.0.0rc3 release where this issue was fixed. The repository directly constrains Transformers to versions from 5.15.0 up to, but excluding, 6.0.0 and installs the committed uv.lock with locked resolution, preventing dependency resolution from selecting an affected release. The moderation implementation does not instantiate Trainer or load Trainer random-number-generator state. This environment is used by CI evaluation moderation and is not packaged in HVE Core release artifacts.

statements.impact_statement: braces 3.0.3 is a development and build-time dependency only. It expands glob patterns, never file contents or file names, and every pattern it can receive is authored in this repository. In the root toolchain it arrives through markdownlint-cli2, which matches files with the main micromatch function; that function compiles patterns with picomatch and never calls braces. In the documentation toolchain, fast-glob expands brace patterns that Docusaurus derives from the site configuration's static directories, and chokidar expands the configured watch paths only while the local development server runs. A pull request that edits those patterns can at most fail its own validation job. The published site is static output and performs no glob expansion at request time. No patched release exists, so the finding is tracked rather than upgraded away.
statements.status_notes: OSV entry: https://osv.dev/GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm. Dependency paths: package-lock.json resolves braces 3.0.3 as a dev dependency through markdownlint-cli2 0.23.3 and micromatch 4.0.8; docs/docusaurus/package-lock.json resolves braces 3.0.3 through @docusaurus/core 3.10.2 via chokidar 3.6.0 and micromatch 4.0.8 (used by fast-glob, @docusaurus/utils, and http-proxy-middleware). Call sites: markdownlint-cli2.mjs filterByGlobs calls micromatch(files, globs); micromatch/index.js invokes braces only from micromatch.parse, micromatch.braces, and micromatch.braceExpand; fast-glob/out/utils/pattern.js expandBraceExpansion calls micromatch.braces; chokidar/index.js calls braces.expand on watched paths; @docusaurus/utils globUtils.js createMatcher uses micromatch.makeRe, which delegates to picomatch. Every parent package is at its latest release. Upstream bump tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/hve-core/issues/3109; Scorecard alert #16 stays open until it is fixed.

statements.impact_statement: http-cache-semantics 4.2.0 is installed only in the documentation toolchain, where its sole consumer is cacheable-request, which got 12.6.1 creates only when a request sets the cache option. The only got caller in the tree is package-json 8.1.1, reached through the Docusaurus update notifier, and it builds its request options from headers and agents alone, so got's default of no cache applies and the cache-policy code is never executed. Nothing in the repository or the published static site uses this package to cache HTTP responses for multiple users. No patched release exists, so the finding is tracked rather than upgraded away.
statements.status_notes: OSV entry: https://osv.dev/GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp. Dependency path: docs/docusaurus/package-lock.json resolves http-cache-semantics 4.2.0 through @docusaurus/core 3.10.2, update-notifier 6.0.2, latest-version 7.0.0, package-json 8.1.1, got 12.6.1, and cacheable-request 10.2.14; no other package depends on cacheable-request or http-cache-semantics. Execute-path evidence: got/dist/source/core/options.js defaults cache to undefined; got/dist/source/core/index.js selects _createCacheableRequest only when options.cache is set; package-json/index.js passes gotOptions containing only headers and agent. Every parent package is at its latest release. Upstream bump tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/hve-core/issues/3109; Scorecard alert #16 stays open until it is fixed.

statements.impact_statement: The committed environment resolves tinypool 2.2.0, which is later than the 2.1.1 release where this issue was fixed. tinypool is a transitive dependency of @docusaurus/core 3.10.2, which uses it at build time to render pages on worker threads, a setting this site enables through future.v4; the published site is static output. @docusaurus/core requires tinypool ^1.0.2 and no 1.x release is patched, so the documentation site's package manifest overrides tinypool to exactly 2.2.0, and the committed package-lock.json resolves that version for clean installs. A clean build that rendered every page through tinypool 2.2.0 produced output identical to the pre-override build apart from content-hash names.

statements.impact_statement: The committed environment resolves a single postcss-selector-parser 7.1.6, the release where this issue was fixed. postcss-selector-parser is a build-time dependency of the documentation site's CSS toolchain (cssnano and postcss-preset-env plugins); the published site is static output. No 6.x release is patched and the cssnano 6 plugins require ^6, so the documentation site's package manifest overrides every copy to exactly 7.1.6, and the committed package-lock.json resolves that version for clean installs. A clean build produced byte-identical CSS to the pre-override build.

statements.impact_statement: sprintf-js is no longer present in any committed dependency tree. It previously arrived only through argparse 1.x, a dependency of the js-yaml 3 command-line binary, which @istanbuljs/load-nyc-config pulls in for Jest coverage. load-nyc-config calls only js-yaml's load function, so the documentation site's package manifest overrides its js-yaml to 4.3.2, which provides the same load function without argparse 1.x. No patched sprintf-js release exists.
